rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or instance of yawning, including one caused by tiredness or boredom.

example.english: When I’m tired, I can’t help letting out a yawn.
example.traditional: 我一攰就忍唔住打個呵欠。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gui6 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 daa2 go3 ho1 him3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for opening your mouth and breathing deeply because you are tired or bored.

example.english: I can't help but yawn when I'm tired.
example.traditional: 我一攰就忍唔住打喊露。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gui6 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 daa2 haam3 lou6

rows.jyutping: jat1 bin1 daa2 haam3 lou6 jat1 bin1 gong2
rows.note: Use this construction when someone says something while yawning, rather than using 打喊露 alone as a speech-reporting verb.

example.english: They yawn as they say, “I’m really sleepy.”
example.traditional: 佢一邊打喊露一邊講：「我真係好眼瞓。」
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 bin1 daa2 haam3 lou6 jat1 bin1 gong2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ngaan5 fan3
